This vignette demonstrates a deterministic end-to-end workflow:
convert, filter, mutate, ROI operations, slice, summarize, and state tracking.

## Deterministic synthetic data

```{r}
library(msidataset)

expr <- matrix(seq_len(5 * 8), nrow = 5, ncol = 8)
sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample_id = paste0("spectrum_", 1:8),
  x = rep(1:4, 2),
  y = rep(c(1, 2), each = 4),
  z = rep(c(1, 2), each = 4),
  subject_id = "subject_demo",
  section_id = rep(c("section_1", "section_2"), each = 4),
  resolution = 50,
  matrix = "CHCA",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
variable_info <- data.frame(
  variable_id = paste0("m", 1:5),
  mz = c(130.06, 191.02, 250.10, 306.07, 401.20),
  ms2 = "no",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
rownames(expr) <- variable_info$variable_id
colnames(expr) <- sample_info$sample_id

obj0 <- create_msi_dataset(expr, sample_info, variable_info)
obj0
```

## Verb flow visualization

```{r}
flow <- msi_show_flow(obj0, verb = "filter")
flow
```

## Convert

`convert_cardinal2msi_dataset()` is demonstrated in package tests with
conditional Cardinal/imzML checks to keep CI deterministic and lightweight.

## Filter

```{r}
obj1 <- filter_msi(
  obj0,
  target = "variable_info",
  filter_type = "mz_range",
  mz_min = 180,
  mz_max = 320
)
dim(obj0)
dim(obj1)
```

## Mutate MS2

```{r}
mgf_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".mgf")
writeLines(c(
  "BEGIN IONS",
  "TITLE=demo_1",
  "PEPMASS=191.0200",
  "RTINSECONDS=10",
  "SCANS=spectrum_1",
  "100.0 200",
  "120.0 50",
  "END IONS"
), mgf_file)

obj2 <- mutate_msi(obj1, method = "ms2", path = mgf_file, ms1.ms2.match.mz.tol = 20)
head(extract_ms2(obj2, what = "ms2_info"))
```

## ROI selection

```{r}
obj3 <- roi_msi(
  obj2,
  action = "add",
  roi_id = "roi_demo",
  sample_id = obj2@sample_info$sample_id[1:2],
  section_id = "section_1",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
roi_msi(obj3, action = "list")
```

## Slice

```{r}
obj4 <- slice_msi(obj3, section_id = "section_1")
dim(obj4)
```

## Summarize

```{r}
sum4 <- summarize_msi(obj4)
sum4
```

## Object state tracking

```{r}
cmp <- compare_msi(obj0, obj4)
cmp
```

## Session info

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```
